scope: Goku preset numeric-identity versus complete-loadout reconciliation

sources.role: current in-game-data table; exposes 19 named main-slot preset/loadout rows and complete skill configurations but uses costume/named labels rather than repository numeric preset labels.
community video chapter index; explicitly labels existing repository numeric Goku presets 2-12 and 14-18.

finding: The two sources complement each other but do not establish a safe one-to-one mapping between repository numeric Goku preset IDs and the named/costume rows in the current in-game-data table. The numeric video index confirms preset identity but does not expose the six/eight-slot configuration; the current Goku table exposes complete configurations but does not label them with the repository numeric IDs. No loadout promotion is justified from row or costume order.
evidence_boundary: Preserve the 16 numeric identities as confirmed observations, but keep their canonical loadout_status unresolved until a source directly binds the numeric preset number to its complete skill configuration.
next: Search for an explicit numeric Goku preset table/game-data identifier that includes the complete skill slots. If unavailable, move to the next unresolved preset family.
